title: Chapter 422
text:
The main members of the mercenary group were the players for the time being. When they disappeared, the only team that he could command would be the Sunil Squad.

During the time that the players disappear, the income of the mercenary group will decrease, so I can temporarily close down and free up time to recruit more people. When Version 20 starts, the Mutation Disaster will erupt, and the Blue Star players will start to connect with the galaxy. Coincidentally, during the version update period, I will have time to prepare.

Now, he had only brought about fifty players, and he had already created a huge profit for himself. Version 20 was the time when profits would explode. Just thinking about it, Han Technician was already looking forward to the next year's harvest.

His goal was to accept thousands of players and make the Black Star Mercenary the faction that guided the players into the galaxy. Of course, this was not as easy as it seemed. He had hidden competitors, which were Godora and Dark-star.

These two organizations would use the planets as battlefields during the Mutation Disaster, and they would engage in local battles. Under such circumstances, the players would choose a faction, and if Han Xiao wanted to interfere, it would be like stealing food from a tiger's mouth.

However, the benefits were obvious. Both sides were focused on fighting, and only he was targeting the players. His position in the hearts of the players, as well as the faction influence and sense of belonging created by Pork Bun's show, would attract the players.

The more players he recruited, the better. This meant that he would have to make ample preparations. The so-called preparations included various benefits, such as equipment, missions, rewards, and so on, to increase his strength and influence. The second was the measures to deal with the Mutation Disaster. The former was targeted at the players, and the latter was targeted at the main storyline.

I have about 800,000 Enas, which is enough to buy two High-End Knowledges and complete the Class Advancement Mission. However, I am currently level 95, and when I reach level 100, I am still stuck on a Class Advancement Mission. Even if I spend all my money, I will only be able to level up five times. The most cost-effective way is to get a subclass first and take a look at the Class Advancement Requirement when I reach level 100. If I cannot complete it in a short time, I will not be in a hurry to spend the 800,000 Enas. I still have around 1.5 billion EXP. I don't have enough EXP to reach Level 120, not to mention, I still have to gamble on recipes and level up my Skills. "

Since there were no players to harvest in this year, Han Xiao started to plan carefully. Level 100 was the second chance for his Race Evolution. He had obtained the Void Genes from the Void Dragon Bone Marrow, and it would affect the path of his Race Evolution. The improvement would be especially great, and he still wanted to advance.

"Secondary professions are easy to find, but those that are too rare are more troublesome …"

Han Xiao searched through his memories. Those fancy and rare subclasses usually required all kinds of complicated operations to obtain. If the difficulty was too high, he would have to put in too much effort, and if the difficulty was too low, it would not be suitable for the Mechanic class. Subclasses were just decorations to him. He did not pursue rarity; he only wanted them to be compatible with the Mechanic class.

"If that's the case, an attribute class isn't bad. Just nice, I can get this class in Juberly Hub. Although it's not rare, its effects are simple."

Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

…

After completing the daily mission of transporting goods on Floating Dragon Island, Han Xiao was called home by Ames as usual to ask about the progress of the search for her teacher. He then brought everyone back to Juberly Hub to rest.

The professional players had just finished a match and were tired. They were all in agreement. Running around in the hub city was much more relaxing, almost like a holiday.

However, Han Xiao was not taking care of them. It was mainly because the version update was coming, and he wanted to take this opportunity to harvest the last wave.

He sold some obsolete machines to the players, occasionally selling some high-quality ones, and then accepting strengthening and repair missions. For this, Han Xiao went into seclusion to build for a few days. When the number of players in the faction increased, no matter how fast he built, he would definitely not be able to keep up with the demand of the players, unless he could build a production line. However, this was still a long way away.

However, Han Xiao had a solution to this problem long ago, which was to increase the NC resources of the faction and use his connections to open up opportunities for the players to go to other maps to do missions and earn money. Sunil was one of the player nurturing bases that he had prepared.

After selling for a few days, Han Xiao took a flying disc carrier and arrived at the fifty-seventh floor of a tall building in the center of the hub city. This was the office of an absolutely neutral organization called the Spacetime Research Association. The name sounded grand, but it had nothing to do with spacetime. This was an association of scholars to store knowledge and exchange knowledge. They had offices in various Star Fields, and the structure was loose.

The Spacetime Research Association aimed to store the information and history of all civilizations in the universe, such as academic knowledge, historical records of universal civilizations, literature of various races, and so on. It was like a knowledge base, and the platform allowed many members to exchange new research topics. The academic atmosphere was thick. This kind of organization was naturally public, and the leader was the Arcane Church. This Universal Civilization had the thickest culture and countless members in various Star Fields. Even the Radiant Federation and the Red Empire joined the management positions of the association later on.

The Spacetime Research Association's inventory contained practical knowledge, such as the technology of different civilizations, magic, Supers, and so on. Practical knowledge was more precious, and those that were too sensitive were usually not displayed to the outside world. This was also a requirement of the advanced civilizations. If one wanted to browse such important knowledge, they had to obtain a higher level of clearance. The only way to increase their relationship with the faction was to donate unknown materials and literature, but increasing their clearance was very complicated. There was no clear way, and they could only wait for the management to filter. First, they had to participate in the various exchange meetings organized by the association to provide new insights, increase their presence, and increase their status and reputation among the members. When they had enough faction connections, been in the association for a long time, had a clean background, and had actual social status, such as having very high positive Legend Points or extremely high faction connections in the advanced civilizations, they would have a chance to have their clearance raised by the management. In short, it was extremely complicated.

In Han Xiao's previous life, the players had only started to pay attention to the Spacetime Research Association in the later stages. At that time, they were looking for the highest class knowledge, which was extremely rare. The research association had the relevant information, and this was one of the ways to obtain the highest class knowledge. However, in order to obtain it, one had to spend a huge amount of time and effort, and there were no shortcuts. Since he would not have any ideas about it for a long time, it was better to join this association early than late. Thus, Han Xiao decided to join now.

There were no requirements to join the association, and all he had to do was pay. Compared to the research association, the entrance fee was much more affordable — only 500 Enas.

Of course, Han Xiao's goal was not so long-term. Joining the research association would give him a secondary class, and that was what he wanted.

…

There were no twists and turns in the procedures. He entered the information, filled in the form, paid, and flirted with the receptionist. The whole process took less than ten minutes.

Walking out of the research association's office, Han Xiao opened the interface, and there was a new option for his secondary class.

Scholar!

There was a secondary class called the 'Attribute Class'. For example, the current Scholar would greatly increase a single attribute every time he leveled up, and there were no Free Attribute Points, only Potential Points.

Scholar would increase his Intelligence by 10 points every time he leveled up, and after leveling up five times in a row, his Intelligence would increase by 50 points.

Intelligence was the core attribute of the Mechanic class, and it was related to Machinery Affinity. One of Han Xiao's current talents was Machinery Analysis, which increased his Machinery Affinity by 1 point every 10 points of Intelligence.

Han Xiao basically put all his points into Intelligence, and his current Intelligence was more than 600 points. This was a core talent, and Han Xiao knew that this was only one of the skills related to the Intelligence attribute of the Mechanic class. He would receive more class skills in the later stages.

Furthermore, the Scholar secondary class gave him another talent called Research Theory, which increased his Intelligence by 1 point for every three skills he mastered. It was extremely suitable for the Mechanic and Mage classes, as both classes were famous for having many skills. Furthermore, both classes enjoyed the bonus of Intelligence. Compared to the Mage class, which still required the Mystery attribute, the Mechanic class had the highest bonus from the Scholar class.

A blueprint for the Mechanic class was considered a skill, and Han Xiao had already understood more than a hundred blueprints. Just the Scholar class alone gave him 90 points of Intelligence.

Of all the secondary classes that were the easiest to obtain, the Attribute Class was the most useful option for Han Xiao.

Every player could easily obtain this type of Attribute Class (provided that they knew about it), and the bonus was extremely significant. Furthermore, it was a growth attribute talent that could even be used in the later stages of the game. In Han Xiao's previous life, many top class players would choose to learn one or two Attribute Class.

Among them, the most impressive one was the 'Luck' attribute class. Just from the name, one could tell what this class was like — Gambler!

He still remembered the effect of the Gambler talent. By winning a certain amount of things through gambling, betting, and so on, one's Luck would increase. As the amount of things won continued to accumulate, the Luck attribute would increase. If one lost a certain amount of things, one's Luck would decrease. This perfectly explained the meaning of the name of this subclass and the Luck attribute.

In fact, Han Xiao really wanted to obtain the Gambler subclass. After all, no matter how much his Luck decreased, it would only go from 1 to 0. It was completely useless. If he won, he would make a killing!

After experiencing the feeling of clarity after leveling up for a while, Han Xiao looked at the interface. The level 100 Promotion Mission was his main goal.

With just one look, Han Xiao suddenly started to doubt his life.
